metadata.name: Mukosozi Word Bank
metadata.creator: Christophe Mumaragishyika
metadata.description: A structured linguistic knowledge base for Kinyarwanda: grammar rules, lexical exceptions, and neologisms. Each entry is reviewed by a native speaker and traceable to a documented rule ID.

grammar_rules.name: Quotative Marker Agreement
grammar_rules.description: The quotative marker (the particle introducing direct or reported speech) must agree with the subject prefix of the reporting verb.
grammar_rules.rule: Subject prefix determines the quotative marker: n- (1sg) -> nti; u- (2sg) -> uti; a- (3sg) -> ati; tu- (1pl) -> tuti; mu- (2pl) -> muti; ba- (3pl) -> bati.

incorrect.error: Singular quotative ('ati') used with plural subject prefix ('ba-')
Singular quotative ('ati') used with plural subject prefix ('tu-')

lexical_exceptions.rule: This noun has no plural form. The form *amakwe (formed by analogy with class 6 ama-) is not valid in standard Kinyarwanda.

incorrect.error: ubukwe has no plural form; should remain as 'ubukwe bwabo bwari bwiza'

lexical_exceptions.definition: A historic town in the Southern Province of Rwanda, known for its Catholic mission established in 1906.
lexical_exceptions.rule: Unique historical spelling preserving the 'bg' consonant cluster. Should not be 'corrected' to phonetic variants such as *kabwayi or *Kagwayi.

incorrect.error: Incorrect spelling; the standard form preserves 'bg' as in 'Kabgayi'
Incorrect spelling; the standard form is 'Kabgayi'

lexical_exceptions.rule: Must be written as two words when 'ni' functions as the copula ('it is'). The contraction 'n'ukuri' is valid only when 'n'' represents 'na' (and / with), not when it represents the copula 'ni'.

correct.translation: It is true that he came
correct.note: 'ni' is the copula 'it is' — must be separated from 'ukuri'
'n'' is a contraction of 'na' (and) — contraction is valid here

incorrect.error: Missing space — the copula 'ni' must be separated from 'ukuri'
Wrong contraction — the copula 'ni' should not be contracted to 'n'' here

neologisms.rationale: Compound describing 'the thing of working together with creation/innovation' — captures both tools and the activity of building or innovating.
neologisms.notes: Adopted by the Rwanda Education Board (REB) and used in official terminology and curricula.

schema.description: This file documents only a curated subset of the maintainer's full linguistic knowledge base. Additional rules, exceptions, and neologisms are added over time as they are verified.
